regulations.description: Requirements for ME equipment and ME systems intended for use in home healthcare environments
Safety sign - keep dry warning marking
Symbol ISO 7000-0626 for carrying case protection

tests.requirement: Usability of identification, marking, and accompanying documents intended for lay operator or lay responsible organization evaluated by an operator whose profile included minimum eight years of education
tests.result_remark: Usability was evaluated in the Usability test report

tests.requirement: ME equipment and ME systems intended for home healthcare environment are simple to use and do not require referencing complex accompanying documents
Carrying case provides ingress protection against water or particulate matter; enclosure marked with ISO 7010-W001 and 'keep dry'
tests.result_remark: The carrying case does not provide ingress protection against water or particulate matter

tests.requirement: A carrying case marked with degree of protection
Carrying case inspected, and tests and criteria of 7.1.2 and 7.1.3 of Part 1 applied
Accompanying documents
Accompanying documents indicate lay operator or lay responsible organization should contact manufacturer for assistance in setting up, using, or maintaining ME equipment or ME system
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MANUFACTURE INFORMATION' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Accompanying documents indicate lay operator should report unexpected operation or events
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'TROUBLESHOOTING' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Accompanying documents include postal address and either phone number or web address for lay operator to contact manufacturer
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MANUFACTURE INFORMATION' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Accompanying documents include necessary details for healthcare professional to brief lay operator on contraindications and precautions
Precautions to be taken in the event of changes in the performance of ME equipment or ME system
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'MAINTENANCE' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Precautions regarding exposure of ME equipment to reasonably foreseeable environmental conditions
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'NOTICE' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Adequate information regarding medicinal substances that ME equipment is designed to administer
Information on any medicinal substances or human blood derivatives incorporated into ME equipment as integral part
The degree of accuracy claimed for ME equipment with a measuring function
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'SPECIFICATIONS' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Instructions for use
Nature of hazard, likely consequences if advice not followed, and precautions for reducing risk described in IFU corresponding to each warning and safety sign
Instructions for use address strangulation due to cables and hoses, particularly due to excessive length
Instructions for use address inhalation or swallowing of small parts
Instructions for use address potential allergic reactions to accessible materials
Instructions for use address contact injuries
Instructions for use include warning: use of accessories, detachable parts, and materials not described in IFU (see 7.9.2.14 of Part 1)
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'NOTICE' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Instructions for use include warning: interconnection of equipment to other equipment not described in IFU (see 16.2 c) indent 9 of Part 1)
Instructions for use include warning: modification of the equipment
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter 'NOTICE' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Instructions for use include warning: use of ME equipment outside its carrying case when some protection is provided by that carrying case (see 8.3.1 and 10.1)
When basic safety or essential performance depends on internal electrical power source, IFU describes typical operation time or number of procedures
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter '1. BATTERY LOADING' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Typical service life of the internal electrical power source described in IFU
tests.result_remark: Described in chapter '1. BATTERY LOADING' of operation guide

tests.requirement: Behaviour of ME equipment while rechargeable internal electrical power source is charging described in IFU
tests.result_remark: No rechargeable INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE

semantic_fragments.content: IEC 60601-1-11 compliance evaluation for home healthcare ME equipment covering clauses 7.1 through 7.4.2. Key findings: (1) Usability evaluated per usability test report for operators with minimum 8 years education. (2) No carrying case ingress protection provided, making all carrying case related sub-clauses N/A. (3) Accompanying documents include manufacturer contact info in 'MANUFACTURE INFORMATION' chapter, troubleshooting in 'TROUBLESHOOTING' chapter, maintenance precautions in 'MAINTENANCE' chapter, and environmental precautions in 'NOTICE' chapter. (4) Device not intended to administer medicinal substances. (5) Accuracy specifications in 'SPECIFICATIONS' chapter. (6) IFU addresses small parts ingestion, allergic reactions, contact injuries, unauthorized accessories, and equipment modification warnings. (7) Battery information in '1. BATTERY LOADING' chapter; no rechargeable internal power source present.
